runs: For each of 28 questions, pick whichever answer feels closer to you. Based on which side you pick more often across four axes — Extraversion/Introversion (E/I), Sensing/Intuition (S/N), Thinking/Feeling (T/F), and Judging/Perceiving (J/P) — we’ll show you a personality type.
This isn’t an official MBTI (Myers-Briggs Type Indicator) assessment — it’s a
inspired by the same concept. It hasn’t been validated as a psychological instrument, so please take it just for fun. For an official assessment, use a certified provider.
